subject: maths
question: The cost of levelling a circular park at Rs. 6.50 per m² is Rs. 36,036. What is the cost (in Rs.) of putting a fence around it at Rs. 18 per m? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of leveling = Rs. 6.50 per m2

Cost of leveling a circular park = Rs. 36,036 

Rate of fencing = Rs. 18 per m 

**Concept used:**

Area of a circle = πR²

Perimeter of a circle = 2πR

Where, R = Radius of the circle 

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the circular park be R

According to the question,

⇒ (22)/(7) × R² × 6.5 = 36036

⇒ R2 = 5544 × (7)/(22)

⇒ R2 = 1764

⇒ R = 42 m

Now,

Required cost

⇒ Perimeter of the circular park × Rate of fencing 

⇒ 2 × (22)/(7) × 42 × 18

⇒ 2 × 22 × 6 × 18

⇒ 4752 (in Rs.) 

**∴ The cost (in Rs.) of putting a fence around is 4752.**
